propositions: Reconcile pass currently lacks preflight validation that all mapped projects and legacy_default are visible to the bridge bot, causing failures to surface deep in fan-out as ACLI errors instead of failing at gate.
A mapped-but-nonexistent project key passes syntactic validation but fails only during outbound mutation to live Jira.
legacy_default is returned verbatim from resolve_project without visibility validation, allowing unbound tickets to create into wrong/nonexistent projects unguarded.

Preflight must probe bot-visible project keys before any mutation using AcliClient._direct_rest_get against Jira Cloud GET /rest/api/3/project/search endpoint with pagination and hard failure on unreachable backend.

Missing or invisible project in required set (mapped projects + legacy_default + query_project fallback when projects empty) must abort with OPERATIONAL_FAILURE and actionable message naming offending keys, never reaching reconcile_once.
Preflight applies only to mutating passes and Cloud backends (backend='jira'); non-Cloud backends and read-only modes (preview/dry-run/reconcile-check) skip the probe and proceed.
